title: Mixed reuse perturbations without a qualified cache planner
formal_object: Terminal generator output F(eta_i,eta_j) for two explicit reuse perturbations; local Jacobians and mixed Hessian around zero.
assumptions: A smooth local expansion must remain valid on actual sampled trajectories.
Probe randomness is coupled and fixed for comparisons; all extra forward/probe evaluations count.
No accepted second-order cache planner or full native quality/resource frontier currently exists.

operations.condition: F has bounded appropriate third derivatives in the visited neighborhood
operations.output: Include mixed Hessian, not only propagated single errors.

operations.condition: Identical trajectory/randomness and complete probe cost
operations.output: Separate pair interaction from additive single effects.

derivation_steps.justification: The multivariate Taylor formula includes both self and cross second-order terms.
Subtract shared zero/single probes; this isolates a local mixed effect under coupled randomness.

derivation_steps.statement: For s candidate positions, all single and pair probes can require O(s^2) generator evaluations before amortization.
derivation_steps.justification: A nonzero mixed effect alone gives no positive net runtime/quality frontier, and probe allocation needs a complete construction.

method_expression: PARTIAL: a coupled mixed-effect diagnostic; an accepted finite probe schedule, cache-policy optimization, residual validity and amortized full native output are absent.
distinguishing_prediction: Mixed effects must be large enough and sufficiently stable across actual repeated reuse to justify the complete cost; this cannot be inferred from one mathematical cross term.
falsifier: Linear propagation or simple caching matches the full frontier, or pair-probe costs exceed savings and/or degrade motion/quality.
closest_alternative: RA-CFGCache, known cache error propagation and paired perturbation diagnostics; existing overlap retained without declaring blinded novelty.
decisive_comparison: Complete original generator/video benchmark and quality-resource comparison with probe/amortization costs; no new Wan/model/data launch is authorized by this card.
legacy_code_audit: Historically parked, no I20 planner/source qualification; existing RA-CFGCache collision and adverse evidence retained.
review_limit: Local Taylor/contrast reviewed; complete method_expression and originality/source audit remain pending.
